name: estimate-below-bar
description: Recorded 2026-10-29 with curl from POST https://sellmycompanydata.com/mcp (public, keyless; the request body is the one the connector sends; no headers kept). tools/call estimate_data_value for 8 staff, founded 2023, US, Slack (made-up figures). Under the 20 staff / 3 year bar, so the server returns a rough band flagged below_bar. Response body verbatim.

content.text:
Rough band: $40K – $114K (United States). Below the size most buyers target.
Rough figure. Your company is below the size most AI labs buy from today (most target 20 to 30+ staff with 3+ years of records). Fewer buyers, so treat this as a floor-to-ceiling guess, not a price. We can still review it.
Basis: scaled down from the benchmark at 20 staff and 3 years.
Not sure what you're allowed to license? Say "check my data rights" and we'll go through your contracts, privacy notices and platform terms with you before any buyer sees anything.
Prefer the website? Your numbers are saved here: https://sellmycompanydata.com/?e=8&f=2023&c=us&t=Slack&utm_source=mcp-other&utm_medium=ai-connector&utm_campaign=estimate-handoff#value
Indicative only, not a market valuation or buyer offer. Subject to eligibility, data review and agreed terms.
